meandiff_meta.hidden_state_index_convention: index i is hidden_states[i]; i=0 is the embedding output, i=k is the residual stream AFTER transformer block k-1. A LoRA on block 21 writes into hidden_states[22].
meandiff_meta.sign_convention: misaligned minus aligned; adding it should induce misalignment (2506.11618 s3.2)
meandiff_meta.method: 2506.11618 s3.1 p.3, verbatim; mean over ANSWER tokens only

provenance.layer_index_convention: hidden_states[i] is the residual stream AFTER block i-1. A LoRA on block L writes into hidden_states[L+1], so the LAYER-MATCHED index for a block-L adapter is L+1.
